A disaster management project to empty the Ganga river
A scheme to build artificial floods on wheat fields
A programme to pump ocean water into the Thar desert
questions.explanation: Operation Flood was launched in 1970 and implemented by the National Dairy Development Board in three phases (1970–1996).
